description: The explanation behind a number, why a cost center went over budget, why a forecast missed, is often the most valuable part of a report, and it is usually the first thing lost: trapped in an email thread, a meeting note, or a spreadsheet that drifts out of sync with the data it was meant to explain. The Aimplan Comment Visual is built for cost center owners, project leaders, and sales managers who need that explanation stored against the exact number it belongs to, inside Power BI itself. Comments are stored against the dimension they explain, such as the account, cost center, project, entity, period, or scenario. Filter the report to a cost center and a month, and only the comments written for that slice appear, so the narrative stays with the number instead of living in a notebook or a side spreadsheet. Comments are written back to the same storage as the other visuals, Aimplan's hosted SaaS service, your own Azure SQL, or your own Fabric SQL with automatic OneLake replication, and every comment is tracked by user and time, with security governing who can comment where. To learn more about Aimplan, visit www.aimplan.com or schedule a demo at https://www.aimplan.com/lm/bookdemo. The Aimplan Comment Visual requires an active Aimplan license to write comments.
